fichas.title: Stairs: construction and profiles
fichas.summary: Reference sheet on stair construction, tread and nosing profiles, handrails, guardrails, space-saving and alternating-tread stairs, and loft access. It describes undercut risers for narrow treads, guardrail heights by drop, and dimensions for loft ladders and floor openings.
uses: Provide stair access where space is limited
Provide access to lofts and flat roofs
Protect galleries, mezzanines, balconies, and theatre seating with guardrails
